sections.label: Opening cell
sections.explanation: Four broad layers alternate sustained columns with more mobile melodic windows. Prepared suspensions at bar 3 delay the new harmony and resolve downward.

sections.label: Contrasting span

sections.label: Cadence
sections.explanation: The upper leading note rises by semitone to the tonic; the inner dominant seventh resolves downward.

composition_notes: Four broad layers alternate sustained columns with more mobile melodic windows.
The broad outer spans now carry a continuous melody. Prepared suspensions give the harmonic columns tension before their resolution.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
